author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Koenig optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Brewers optioned Jared Koenig to Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Koenig will return to Triple-A to make room for Lance McCullers Jr.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez (concussion) not in lineup Friday
desc: Julio Rodriguez remains out of the Mariners lineup on Friday against the Giants.
impact: Rodriguez remains on the concussion injured list. There should be an update on his status over the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yohel Pozo designated for assignment
desc: The Cardinals designated Yohel Pozo for assignment.
impact: Pozo loses his spot on the 40-man roster for St. Louis to make room for Scott Blewett.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Scott Blewett has contract selected by Cardinals
desc: The Cardinals selected the contract of Scott Blewett.
impact: Blewett was set to become a free agent if the Cardinals didn't select his contract. He gets his opportunity with JoJo Romero placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JoJo Romero (appendicitis) placed on IL
desc: The Cardinals placed JoJo Romero on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Romero will be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks as he deals with appendicitis.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) hopeful to return by mid-August
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said the best case scenario for Will Smith is to return by mid-August.
impact: Smith is resting his sore neck this week. He is not dealing with any pain as of now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lenyn Sosa (wrist) suffers setback on rehab assignment
desc: Lenyn Sosa recently suffered a setback on his rehab assignment.
impact: Sosa is currently at the Blue Jays complex in Florida ramping back up. He resumed hitting this week in the batting cages.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani expected to pitch Wednesday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani is expected to pitch against the Phillies on Wednesday.
impact: Ohtani is in the Dodgers lineup on Friday, but he is not scheduled to pitch this weekend. He received a lubricant injection in his left knee after having that same knee drained during All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Clarke Schmidt (elbow) to face live hitters Saturday
desc: Clarke Schmidt is scheduled to throw live batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Schmidt will face live hitters for the first time as he continues to work his way back from Tommy John surgery.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Giancarlo Stanton (calf) resumes running
desc: Giancarlo Stanton has resumed outdoor running.
impact: Stanton is continuing to slowly work his way back from a right calf strain. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Rodon (elbow) throws bullpen Thursday
desc: Carlos Rodon threw a bullpen session on Thursday.
impact: Rodon was able to throw 10 pitches. He will likely require multiple more bullpen sessions before he gets cleared to face live hitters.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) to have update Sunday
desc: Brandon Woodruff is expected to address the media for an update on his shoulder injury on Sunday.
impact: "The outlook isn't good," Brewers manager Pat Murphy said. "I'm going to let Woody get specific with you and let him be the one to announce what he wants to announce."

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Englert to start Game 2 for Rays
desc: Mason Englert will start in Game 2 of Friday's doubleheader against the Red Sox.
impact: Englert was added as the 27th man. He allowed two runs over 5 2/3 innings in a start earlier in July against the Astros.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Thaiss released by Red Sox
desc: The Red Sox released Matt Thaiss.
impact: Thaiss will get an figure to seek another opportunity in free agency.
